steps.name: Parse CIDs
steps.rule: All CIDs MUST parse with a real CID implementation.

steps.name: Validate fetched Block
steps.rule: Fetched block.json MUST validate as a core ALX Block.

steps.name: Recompute content identity
steps.rule: Fetched content MUST recompute to manifest.contentHash.

steps.name: Resolve parent mappings
steps.rule: Each parent CID SHOULD resolve to a Block whose blockHash equals the declared parent blockHash.

steps.name: Recompute local block CID
steps.rule: When block.json is available locally, manifest.blockCid MUST equal the CID computed from the exact block.json bytes.

steps.name: Recompute local content CID
steps.rule: When content.json is available locally, manifest.contentCid MUST equal the CID computed from the exact content.json bytes.

steps.name: Recompute local parent CIDs
steps.rule: When resolved parent Block files are available locally, each manifest parent CID MUST equal the CID computed from that parent file's exact bytes.

steps.name: Separate local CID verification from live retrieval
steps.rule: Local CID verification MUST NOT be presented as proof of live gateway retrieval, provider pinning, or network availability.
